```python name=advanced/sockets.py
# ============================================================
# SOCKET PROGRAMMING — Low-Level Network Communication
# ============================================================
import socket
import json

# --- TCP Server ---
def run_tcp_server(host="localhost", port=9999):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as server:
        server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        server.bind((host, port))
        server.listen(5)
        print(f"Server listening on {host}:{port}")
        
        while True:
            client, address = server.accept()
            with client:
                print(f"Connection from {address}")
                data = client.recv(4096)
                response = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "received": data.decode()})
                client.sendall(response.encode())

# --- TCP Client ---
def tcp_client(host="localhost", port=9999, message="Hello"):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as sock:
        sock.connect((host, port))
        sock.sendall(message.encode())
        response = sock.recv(4096)
        return json.loads(response.decode())

# --- UDP (connectionless, faster, unreliable) ---
def udp_server(host="localhost", port=9998):
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
        sock.bind((host, port))
        while True:
            data, addr = sock.recvfrom(4096)
            sock.sendto(b"ACK: " + data, addr)
```
